notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Roundup, one idea ("it all runs on your level"): every beat is one line from the app: slider 5 to 60 (quickMissionConfig), "Your level sets the difficulty" (levelStory / athleteLevel), "Combo Coach opens on your Fight level and deals combos to match", GUIDED | AT YOUR PACE, "MAX OUT: max reps on a move, then switch." (loadoutMissions MAX OUT help), five workouts BOSS RUSH, HEALTH BAR, COMBO METER, TANK MODE, DUAL WIELD, "Where you stand and what is next." (LevelView subtitle).
No XP, no unlock, no exact-minutes claim anywhere. The MAX OUT score is total reps; the XP is time plus the finish (maxRepsXp), so the reel says nothing about XP.

Footage: each scene's window in the clip is in "timeline". The clips are recorded from the live app by npm run app-broll (needs a built export of the app); after the app changes, re-run it and re-check every window.
